overview: Floor is Lava is a compact staged-ascent fixture presented as an evacuation under rising lava. Activate two tier beacons before using the evacuation transponder. The implemented hazard is a rising lava counter with an explicit timeout loss.
rules: Activate the first-tier beacon to enable the second-tier beacon.
Activate the second-tier beacon to enable evacuation; disabled stages ignore interaction.
The lava counter rises every timer pulse and loses the match at level six.
Use the evacuation transponder after both checkpoints to win.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The scenario is an unnamed survivor’s evacuation from rising lava. No named story cast or longer narrative is documented.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
